_comment: Register the NYSE_DATA options engine as an MCP server. For Claude Desktop, merge one of the entries below into claude_desktop_config.json (Windows: %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json). 'nyse-options' runs it natively (adjust the python path / use a venv); 'nyse-options-docker' runs it from the container image (build first: docker build -t nyse-options:latest . — see docs/DOCKER.md). Pick ONE. The server imports telegram_bot_optimized as a library (read-only tools) and speaks JSON-RPC over stdio.
